## Positioning
Product-minded engineer who turns business goals into scalable web products. Frontend-leaning full-stack: owns UI architecture, TypeScript/Node/Python/React/Vue, and the integration layer (REST, GraphQL, third-party APIs, payments, comms, maps). Strong at owning features end-to-end — from scoping and technical specifications to delivery — while bridging product, design, and engineering. Comfortable operating what ships (testing, observability, tech debt). Currently deepening agentic AI, data engineering, and modern product development practices while consulting on digital solutions.

**Strong fit for:** Roles that combine product sense, web delivery, integrations, and agentic AI.

## Executive Summary
Bridges business and technology to deliver data-driven, user-centric products across logistics, mobility, fintech, data analytics, energy, and supply chain. Experienced collaborating with international teams in agile environments. Uses web technologies, API integrations, and product strategy to transform complex requirements into high-impact digital solutions.

## Core capabilities
- **Product engineering:** RFCs, specs, prototyping, agile delivery (Scrum/Kanban), stakeholder alignment, product ownership (PSPO-I, PSM-I, PAL-I), mentoring
- **Frontend-leaning full-stack:** React, Vue, Angular, TypeScript, Node.js; UI architecture; design-system and testing culture (Jest, Cypress, Storybook, Vitest, Playwright)
- **Integrations:** REST, GraphQL, payment gateways, SMS/email, Twilio, Intercom, route planning (Routific), Google Maps, partner APIs; contract validation with backend/QA
- **agentic AI:** AI-assisted PoCs and product tooling; DialogFlow KPI chatbot; GenAI for Product Managers (PMI); actively building agentic AI and data-engineering practice
- **Data & analytics:** BI/ETL literacy, dashboards, product analytics (Amplitude, GA), GIS/maps
